# Association of Genomic and IMC (here myeloid) data 

## Software requirments 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(ggpubr)
```

# Read in data 

```{r}
# Read in genomics data 
## 1A: Mutations 
mut_anno <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/variant_combined_full_withmeta.csv")
mut_per_PID <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/mutation_per_PID_binary.csv")
  
## 1B: Genomic subtypes 
genomic_sub <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/genomic_subtype_anno_final.csv")
```

# Differential abundance testing based 

## 1. Immune subtypes

```{r}
# Read and subset sce object 
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")

# Subset for PID for which we have genomics data
sce <- sce[,sce$PID %in% genomic_sub$PID]
```


```{r}
# Add relevant metadata to sce 
mut_per_PID <- as.data.frame(mut_per_PID)

# Mutation encoding 
## Only clonal 
mut_per_PID_clonal <- mut_per_PID
mut_per_PID_clonal[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)] <- ifelse(mut_per_PID_clonal[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)] >= 1, 1,0)
colnames(mut_per_PID_clonal)[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)] <- paste0(colnames(mut_per_PID_clonal)[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)], "_clonal")
GOI_clonal <- colnames(mut_per_PID_clonal %>% select(-PID))

for (entry in GOI_clonal) {
  colData(sce)[,entry] <- mut_per_PID_clonal[,entry][match(colData(sce)[,"PID"],mut_per_PID_clonal[,"PID"])]
}

## All 
mut_per_PID_all <- mut_per_PID
mut_per_PID_all[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_all)] <- ifelse(mut_per_PID_all[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_all)] >= 0.5, 1,0)
colnames(mut_per_PID_all)[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_all)] <- paste0(colnames(mut_per_PID_all)[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_all)], "_all")
GOI_all <- colnames(mut_per_PID_all %>% select(-PID))

for (entry in GOI_all) {
  colData(sce)[,entry] <- mut_per_PID_all[,entry][match(colData(sce)[,"PID"],mut_per_PID_all[,"PID"])]
}
```


```{r}
# Add relevant metadata to sce 
## Genomic subtypes and evolution type 
genom_add <- colnames(genomic_sub)[colnames(genomic_sub) %in% c("genomic_subtype", "evolution_type", "evolution_type_comb")]

genomic_sub <- as.data.frame(genomic_sub)

for (entry in genom_add) {
  colData(sce)[,entry] <- genomic_sub[,entry][match(colData(sce)[,"PID"],genomic_sub[,"PID"])]
}
```

```{r}
# Create binary categories 
## Genomic subtypes
sce$VHL_wildtype <- ifelse(sce$genomic_subtype == "VHL_wildtype", "1", "0")
sce$PBRM1_driven <- ifelse(sce$genomic_subtype == "PBRM1_driven", "1", "0")
sce$BAP1_driven <- ifelse(sce$genomic_subtype == "BAP1_driven", "1", "0")
sce$VHL_monodriver <- ifelse(sce$genomic_subtype == "VHL_monodriver", "1", "0")
sce$multiple_drivers <- ifelse(sce$genomic_subtype == "multiple_drivers", "1", "0")

## Evolutionary subtypes
sce$punctuated_like <- ifelse(sce$evolution_type == "punctuated_like", "1", "0")
sce$branched_like <- ifelse(sce$evolution_type == "branched_like", "1", "0")
sce$linear_like <- ifelse(sce$evolution_type == "linear_like", "1", "0")
```


### Mutation types 

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

GOI_all <- GOI_all[!GOI_all %in% c("SF3B1_all","ELOC_all","STAG2_all","ARHGAP35_all")]
  
DA <- lapply(GOI_all, function(x){

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster_combined), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]

meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.1, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
DA_out$result <- ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_out %>% select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order


DA_out$cluster <- factor(DA_out$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
                             ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))
```

```{r}
# Select myeloid cells only 
DA_out <- DA_out[str_detect(DA_out$cluster, "MY"),]
DA_out <- DA_out[complete.cases(DA_out),]

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_out %>% select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order


DA_out$cluster <- factor(DA_out$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

GOI_clonal <- GOI_clonal[!GOI_clonal %in% c("SF3B1_clonal","ELOC_clonal","STAG2_clonal","ARHGAP35_clonal")]
  
DA <- lapply(GOI_clonal, function(x){

abundances <- table(sce_immune$celltype_combined, sce_immune$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce_immune)[match(colnames(abundances), sce_immune$PID),]

meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.1, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

##### Myeloid cell proportions

```{r}
# Subset to just myeloid cells
sce_MY <- sce_immune[,str_detect(sce_immune$celltype_combined, "MY")]
```

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("punctuated_like", "branched_like", "linear_like"), function(x){

abundances <- table(sce_MY$celltype_combined, sce_MY$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce_MY)[match(colnames(abundances), sce_MY$PID),]

meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.1, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
DA_out$result <- ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_out %>% select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order


DA_out$cluster <- factor(DA_out$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.1, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
DA_out$result <- ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_out %>% select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order


DA_out$cluster <- factor(DA_out$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
DA_out$result <- ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_out %>% select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order


DA_out$cluster <- factor(DA_out$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```



# Regression based

```{r}
PID_celltype_combined <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_celltype_combined <- PID_celltype_combined %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))
PID_metagroups <- PID_celltype_combined %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "celltype_combined",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")



## Add subtypes 
PID_metagroups$BAP1_driven <- sce_MY$BAP1_driven[match(rownames(PID_metagroups), sce_MY$PID)]
PID_metagroups$BAP1_driven <- as.factor(PID_metagroups$BAP1_driven)
PID_metagroups$BAP1_driven <- relevel(x=PID_metagroups$BAP1_driven, ref = "0")

PID_metagroups$PBRM1_driven <- sce_MY$PBRM1_driven[match(rownames(PID_metagroups), sce_MY$PID)]
PID_metagroups$PBRM1_driven <- as.factor(PID_metagroups$PBRM1_driven)
PID_metagroups$PBRM1_driven <- relevel(x=PID_metagroups$PBRM1_driven, ref = "0")

PID_metagroups$multiple_drivers <- sce_MY$multiple_drivers[match(rownames(PID_metagroups), sce_MY$PID)]
PID_metagroups$multiple_drivers <- as.factor(PID_metagroups$multiple_drivers)
PID_metagroups$multiple_drivers <- relevel(x=PID_metagroups$multiple_drivers, ref = "0")
```

```{r}
#logit transform 
PID_metagroups <- as.data.frame.matrix(apply(PID_metagroups, 2, function(x){log(x / (1 - x))}))

PID_metagroups$MY_Ag_M[PID_metagroups$MY_Ag_M == -Inf] <- min(PID_metagroups$MY_Ag_M[PID_metagroups$MY_Ag_M != -Inf])

PID_metagroups <- as.data.frame.matrix(apply(PID_metagroups, 2, function(x){
  x[x == -Inf] <- min(x[x != -Inf])
  return(x)
  }))
  
```

```{r}
# Logistic regression
glm_out <- glm(multiple_drivers ~ MY_C_M + MY_M2_like + MY_Neutro_MDSC + MY_Ag_M + MY_M1_like, data = PID_metagroups, family = binomial)
summary(glm_out)

# Linear regression 
lm_out <- lm(multiple_drivers ~ MY_C_M + MY_M2_like + MY_Neutro_MDSC + MY_Ag_M + MY_M1_like, data = PID_metagroups)
summary(lm_out)
```
